start_here: Say to your AI: "Is my Resend domain 4dd369bc-aa82-4ff3-97de-514ae3000ee0 verified, and how is each DNS record doing?" It runs tool:read-an-email-sending-domain.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of yours: it reads one domain of your email-sending account by its id and writes nothing.
instructions: 1. Connect your Resend account once so your key is held under the name resend-api-key; the key is never typed into the request.
2. Get the domain id from tool:add-an-email-sending-domain (its answer) or the account's list.
3. Say to your AI: "Read my Resend domain <id>". It calls tools:run with tool tool:read-an-email-sending-domain and {"domain_id": "<id>"} (letters, digits and dashes only).
4. Read status and each record's own status. When every record says verified, the domain can send; if not, run tool:check-an-email-sending-domain after fixing DNS.

worked_examples.title: A domain with one record verified and one still waiting
worked_examples.given: Read from tools/email-sending-domains/tool-rows.json: the row sends GET https://api.resend.com/domains/4dd369bc-aa82-4ff3-97de-514ae3000ee0 with your key in the Authorization header and returns Resend's reply unchanged. The record states are a synthetic sample.
